# template-cf-fullstack

> A Cloudflare Workers + TanStack Start application built from template-cf-fullstack.
> Replace this content with a brief description of your app for AI agents.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) — a short, plaintext index of the most important pages and resources for AI agents that visit this site. Edit it as your app grows.

## API

- [/openapi.json](/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [/.well-known/api-catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): Pointer to the API contract per the API Catalog spec

## Discovery

- [/robots.txt](/robots.txt): Crawler and bot directives
- [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml): URL inventory

## Optional capabilities

- [/.well-known/mcp-server-card](/.well-known/mcp-server-card): MCP server descriptor (returns 404 unless the mcp/expose-app-as-mcp-server recipe is installed)
